options.eager_nockpt: eager, geo_checkpoint=False (store the (B,N,S,.) geometry instead of recomputing it)
options.eager_ckpt_slow_softmax: eager, geo_checkpoint=True, fast_point_softmax=False: the pre-2026-09-10 middle-dimension point softmax, the configuration behind the book's GB300 '3.7x' matched-memory number
options.compile_model_ckpt: torch.compile(model) (the recipe's compile: true path), geo_checkpoint=True
options.compile_model_nockpt: torch.compile(model), geo_checkpoint=False (Inductor's own min-cut recompute decides what is saved)
options.compile_blocks_ckpt: torch.compile on each _SliceBlock.forward only (embed/head eager), geo_checkpoint=True
options.compile_model_dynamic: torch.compile(model, dynamic=True): one kernel set for every token count
options.fused_geo_eager: geo_kernel='fused' (Triton fused geometry region, recompute built in), rest eager
options.fused_geo_compile_model: geo_kernel='fused' + torch.compile(model) (fused region is an opaque custom op inside the compiled graph)
